correctness.rationale: Constant width gives \(K-K=wB_2\), hence singleton support faces. Its curvature-measure identity makes the support-point map Lipschitz. The unoriented diameter sweep is a Lipschitz map from a Möbius strip whose boundary winds once. Rademacher plus the area formula removes nondifferentiability and zero-Jacobian images as null sets, while each remaining isolated preimage has local mod-2 degree one. Published mean-multiplicity theory supplies finite fibers almost everywhere, so finite multiplicity is odd almost everywhere.
